decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm's core heat-exchange business and the firm is growing with R&D and investment slack, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it on the market.
As a close extension of the established condenser offering in a growing market, it is likely to remain unless it quickly falls well below aspiration levels, which is not indicated here.

Although another closely related condenser product may create some overlap and internal comparison pressure, the firm's slack and strong related capabilities still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
This repair-oriented product builds directly on the firm's lifecycle service model and installed-base capabilities, so it is likely to be kept as a complementary offer.
A customized industrial air cooler fits the firm's stated strategy of tailored integrated solutions, so management would likely continue it while learning from market response.
Because it strengthens aftermarket repair and maintenance services around the firm's existing equipment base, it is especially well aligned with current capabilities and unlikely to be dropped soon.
